summary.text: Mike Burns is a Republican member of the South Carolina House of Representatives who represents District 17, having assumed office on March 12, 2013, and is seeking re-election in the general election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia describes him as a businessman and notes that the Republican primary for his seat was canceled.

paragraphs.text: Burns earned a B.S. from the University of South Carolina in 1974 and is a businessman, according to Ballotpedia.

He is assigned to the Agriculture, Natural Resources and Environmental Affairs Committee in the 2025-2026 session and also served on the Regulations and Administrative Procedures Committee in the 2023-2024 session.
